tail:
Completed `frontier-10` batch 3.

- Authored all 58 settled items: 44 A-page items and 14 examples/counterexamples.
- No additions, drops, renames, merges, dependency changes, or split.
- All items are `draft` / `session` with statement and proof provenance.
- A summary is exactly two sub-150-word paragraphs; B has no summary body.
- No applied `\iota(n)` notation.

Harvest: 118 headings — 92 included, 14 inline, 5 already published, 5 deferred, and 2 out of scope. Included rows map to 47 distinct authored items.

All 392 proof-contract boundary cases are disposed: 211 checked and 181 specifically not applicable. This covers zero polynomials and degree, constant divisors, zero dividends, `(0,0)` gcd exclusion, degree-zero roots, the trivial subgroup, zero indeterminates, zero rational roots, content positivity, constants and positive characteristic in differentiation, both separability directions, degree-one Eisenstein cases, and distinct residue witnesses.

Batch-scoped validation is fully green:

- Precheck: 49/49
- Rendercheck: 60/60 owned files
- Content policy: 58/58
- Coverage: 118/118
- Proof contracts: 49/49 strict
- Global prosecheck: green

Shared-tree blocker: the bare global precheck, depcheck, and rendercheck remain red because other frontier-10 batches are actively authoring out-of-scope files. Their final counts were respectively 51, 48, and 19 failures; none names a batch-3 artifact. I did not edit those files or run the prohibited aggregate wrapper.
